items.text: Mediators from Qatar reports that progress has been made in efforts to end the war between the United States and Iran. ((Reuters))

The Liberian-flagged bulk carrier Minoan Pioneer is reported to be missing in the Strait of Hormuz after it was struck by a unknown projectile northeast of Oman. ((Seatrade Maritime News)) ((Al Arabiya)) ((Haaretz))
Shipping data from Kpler reports that Iraq has exported over 30 million barrels of crude oil through the strait between July 4 and August 4. ((Asharq Al-Awsat))
It is reported that the United States Army has used most of its ATACMS and Precision Strike missiles during the war in Iran including Operation Epic Fury. ((Military Times)) ((Reuters))
A mass funeral is held for 112 bodies that were recovered from a Israeli strike in the Sabra neighborhood of Gaza City during the early weeks of the war. ((Haaretz))

Yemen's internationally recognized government says a projectile attack sank the Indian-flagged cargo ship MSV Faize Noore Oliya in the Red Sea near the coast of Hodeidah, with all 14 crew members rescued. ((AFP via Arab News))

Rapid Support Forces senior commander and brigadier general Mahdi Adam Ismail, also known as Jebel Moon, is confirmed to be killed during clashes with the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Joint Forces in West Darfur, Sudan. His death is confirmed by Sudan Liberation Movement leader and Darfur governor Minni Arko Minnawi. ((Sudan Tribune)) ((Sudan Nabaa))
Health Canada announces it has given Moderna the green light for authorization to launch a clinical trial for a mRNA Ebola vaccine aimed at targeting the Bundibugyo strain of the ebolavirus. ((CBC))
Austria records in Vienna, the highest temperature in the country's history, as a heat wave also brings wildfires and historically low Danube water levels. ((Xinhua))
The Bradley Creek fire in North Okanagan, British Columbia, Canada destroys 250 homes on the North Okanagan Indian reservation in a night with 150km/h winds.((Global News))

The United States revokes the visa of Brazilian ambassador Maria Luiza Ribeiro Viotti to reciprocate Brazil's denial of visas to two U.S. diplomats. The State Department says the action does not expel Viotti from the country. ((AFP via New Straits Times))

The Colombian Special Jurisdiction for Peace charges 27 former FARC members, including ex-commander Timoleón Jiménez, with crimes against humanity and sexual violence committed during the conflict, including killings, disappearances, displacement, and rape. ((AFP via The Manila Times))
Kyrgyz president Sadyr Japarov signs a law banning the use of cremation for deceased human bodies in Kyrgyzstan. ((AKIPress)) ((Kabar))
South Sudanese police arrest 60 suspected gang members in a series of operations targeting criminal gangs, drug trafficking and youth delinquency in Juba. ((Sudans Post))
Four people are killed and four others are injured in a shooting spree by a rogue Russian soldier in Sevastopol, Russian-occupied Crimea. ((CBS News))
